interface.title: ASReview LAB
interface.field: Evidence synthesis / systematic reviewing (any discipline; demo data is clinical psychology and medicine)
interface.stage_of_work: Title/abstract screening of literature search results, before full-text review
interface.what_it_is_for: Screen imported search results one record at a time, in an order set by an active-learning model that learns from each relevant or not-relevant decision. Track progress against a stopping rule, then export the labelled records or the whole project.

data.note: screening_demo.csv has 11 rows. The app hid 1 duplicate, leaving 10 records. 8 of them already carried labels in the file (4 relevant, 4 not relevant), and the app added these automatically as prior knowledge, so only 2 records were left unlabelled. I labelled one as prior knowledge and screened the other, so the screening queue ran out after a single record. Screens under check/screens/ are the replay agent's own and are separate from the explorer's screens/ files.

features.name: Dataset import summary
features.general: After loading a set of records, report how many were found, how many duplicates were hidden, how complete the key fields are, and whether labels already in the file will be used as training examples
features.specific: Start project dialog summary: record count, duplicates hidden, % of records with title / abstract / URL or DOI, and a note that labels found in the dataset are added as prior knowledge
steps: Upload a dataset from the FILE tab
Read the record and hidden-duplicate counts
Check the field-availability percentages
Note how many dataset labels became prior knowledge
serves_tasks: Bring in a set of bibliographic records to screen

features.name: Prior-knowledge seeding panel
features.general: Before a model starts ranking, look over the example labels already in the data, search the collection for more known examples, and mark each one positive or negative so the model has a training seed
features.specific: Start-project 'Prior knowledge': shows labels found in the dataset, a Search dialog that lists matching unlabelled records with Relevant / Not relevant buttons, a running count, and per-record ⋮ menus (Change label, Edit tags, Add note)
steps: Open Show records to see existing labels, filtered by Relevant / Not relevant / All labeled
Press Search and type keywords
Press Relevant or Not relevant on a record that matches the search
Return and check the updated count
Optionally flip a label, edit tags or attach a note from the ⋮ menu
serves_tasks: Seed the model with records already known to be relevant or irrelevant
Write a justification on a record

features.name: Composable active-learning model picker
features.general: Choose a preset ranking model, or build one from interchangeable parts: how items are turned into features, which classifier is used, how class imbalance is handled, and how the next item is picked
features.specific: AI 'Select learner' dropdown: ELAS Ultra / Language-agnostic / Heavy presets, or Custom with Querier (Maximum), Feature extractor (OneHot / TF-IDF), Classifier (Logistic regression / Naive Bayes / Random forest / SVM) and Balancer (Balanced Sample Weight)
steps: Open Select learner and pick a preset; some are greyed out with 'Requires ASReview-Dory'
Or pick Custom, which shows a warning that it trains in the background
Choose a feature extractor
Choose a classifier
Choose a balancer (and querier)

features.name: Custom tag-group schema
features.general: Define a named group of extra checkbox categories, each with a machine-friendly export name, that then show up on every record to be coded alongside the main decision
features.specific: Labeling tags > Add group of tags: a group label and export name, plus tag rows with label and export name (more rows via +). The group then appears as checkboxes on each Reviewer card and in Collection's Edit tags
steps: Press Add tags
Type a group label; the export name fills in automatically
Type tag labels, adding rows with +
Press Create Group
Tick tags while screening, or later via Edit tags
serves_tasks: Define extra categories for coding records beyond include/exclude
Decide whether the top-ranked record is relevant, and code it
Change the coding or decision on a record already labelled

features.name: One-at-a-time screening card
features.general: Show one item at a time, chosen by the model; the reviewer can tick categories and add a note, then make a binary decision, which retrains the model and brings up the next item
features.specific: Reviewer card: title, DOI link, abstract and keywords; Study design tag checkboxes; note icon (Add note dialog); Relevant / Not relevant buttons; a 'Warming up the AI!' screen whose 'I can't wait' skip offers Random or Top down; a 'Finished' screen when the queue is empty. Quirk: saving a note cleared a tag ticked before it
steps: Wait for the model to warm up, or press 'I can't wait' and choose Random or Top down
Read the presented record
Optionally add a note
Tick any tags (after the note, since saving a note can clear earlier ticks)
Press Relevant or Not relevant; the next record loads, or the Finished screen appears
serves_tasks: Decide whether the top-ranked record is relevant, and code it

features.name: Stopping-rule threshold panel
features.general: Set a stopping rule as a run of consecutive negative decisions, either as an absolute number or as a percentage of the collection, and watch the current run against it
features.specific: Dashboard 'Stopping' > Set Threshold popover with CUSTOM (number input + Save) and PERCENTAGE (1/2/5/10% chips showing the record count each gives) tabs; afterwards it shows Threshold vs Current next to a progress donut
steps: Press Set Threshold
Pick the CUSTOM or PERCENTAGE tab
Type a number or click a percentage chip
Press Save
Watch Current vs Threshold as screening goes on

features.name: Screening progress dashboard
features.general: Summarise labelling progress (positives found, negatives, items left) and show how discovery has developed over time in several chart views
features.specific: Dashboard Progress donut (Relevant / Not Relevant counts, each with an including-priors figure, and Unlabeled), tabs HISTORY (Chronological / Grouped), DENSITY, RECALL, WAVE with chart download buttons
steps: Open Dashboard
Read the Relevant / Not relevant / Unlabeled counts
Switch History between Chronological and Grouped
Switch to the Density / Recall / Wave tabs (download buttons sit beside the charts)
serves_tasks: See how many records are labelled and how many relevant ones were found

features.name: Model word-importance view
features.general: Show which words the model currently weighs most for positive and for negative decisions, as a window into what it has learned
features.specific: Dashboard Insights > WORDS OF IMPORTANCE: one word list for relevant records and one for not-relevant records
steps: Open Dashboard
Scroll to Insights
Compare the relevant and not-relevant word lists
serves_tasks: See which words the model associates with each decision

features.name: Labelled-collection browser with relabelling
features.general: List all decided items by outcome, narrow them by annotations, and correct a decision, tags or note in place
features.specific: Collection: Relevant / Not relevant / Full history chips, a Filter dropdown (Contains note, Prior knowledge), and a per-record ⋮ menu (Change to Relevant/Not relevant, Edit tags, Change note)
steps: Pick the Relevant / Not relevant / Full history chip
Add a filter such as Contains note
Open ⋮ on a record
Edit tags or the note, or flip the label
See the record move to the other list
serves_tasks: Browse labelled records by decision and filter by annotation
Change the coding or decision on a record already labelled

features.name: Export records dialog
features.general: Choose which decision classes to export and a file format, and whether to include hidden duplicates (no file was produced in this run)
features.specific: Collection > Export: checkboxes for Relevant / Not relevant / Not seen (yet), Export file format (CSV, TSV, RIS greyed out, Excel), and an 'Include hidden records' toggle
steps: Press Export
Tick the record classes
Choose a format
Toggle hidden duplicates
Press Export
serves_tasks: Export the labelled records for the next stage

features.name: Portable project archive
features.general: Package a whole review (records, labels, settings, history) as a single file that can be moved, shared or reopened later
features.specific: Reviews list ⋯ > Export project downloads a .asreview file; the start dialog's IMPORT tab takes a .asreview file back in
steps: Open the review's ⋯ menu on the Reviews list
Press Export project to download the .asreview file
To reopen, drop the .asreview file on the IMPORT tab of the start dialog (seen, not tried)
serves_tasks: Save the whole review, with labels, settings and history, as a portable file
